// what this is: Workspace settings for an inventory, for people who would rather not build
the extension next to this file. Copy into .vscode/settings.json at the root
of your inventory. docs/lsp.md explains what each half buys you.
The schema half needs only redhat.vscode-yaml and gives key completion and
single-document validation with no netviz process at all. The server half
needs a generic LSP bridge extension and gives everything that spans more
than one document: resolving references, hover, rename, quick fixes.
Running both is the intended arrangement.
